text:
Unfortunately, you're not eligible for a refund. Leafy Plus is fully refundable only if you cancel within 14 days of purchase or renewal **and** haven't used any benefits. You're at day 10, which is within the window, but using the free shipping counts as a benefit used.

If you cancel, you'd keep your Plus benefits until the end of your paid year, but you wouldn't get money back. I can't see anything in our policy that makes an exception here. If you'd like your situation reviewed anyway, I can escalate it to a Support Lead.
